subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding that people trade goods and services with one another to get things they need
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to Financial Literacy's earning concepts — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a simple trade of goods or services with a classmate or persona
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a good or service to the person who might provide it in a community
exercise.abstract: Student explains why people trade goods and services instead of making everything themselves

misconception_flags: believes everyone in a community makes everything they need without any trade or exchange

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
